# Ibiza Private Drivers
> Professional private transfer and chauffeur service based in Ibiza, Spain.
> Operating 24/7 across the entire island of Ibiza and Formentera.

## About
Ibiza Private Drivers is a licensed private transportation company specialising in airport transfers, chauffeur hire, villa transfers and yacht/port transfers across Ibiza (Balearic Islands, Spain). The company serves individuals, families, groups, corporate clients, yacht crews and villa guests.

## Services

### Airport Transfers — Ibiza Airport (IBZ)
Private door-to-door transfers from Ibiza Airport (IATA: IBZ) to any destination on the island. Features include meet & greet with name board in arrivals hall, real-time flight tracking with automatic adjustment for delays, free waiting time, and fixed all-inclusive pricing. Available 24/7 including public holidays and peak season.

### Chauffeur Service Ibiza
Full-day and half-day private chauffeur hire across the island. Suitable for business travel, VIP clients, special events, wedding transportation, and island exploration. Vehicles are new Mercedes-Benz models with professional, uniformed, discreet drivers.

### Villa Transfers Ibiza
Discreet door-to-door service for guests staying in private villas across Ibiza. The company works with leading villa concierge and management companies. Drivers are experienced with high-profile clientele and private property access.

### Yacht and Port Transfers
Professional transfers for yacht owners, crew and guests arriving or departing at marinas across Ibiza including Marina Ibiza, Club Náutico Santa Eulalia, and the port of Sant Antoni.

## Fleet
- Mercedes-Benz E-Class and S-Class saloons (up to 3 passengers + luggage)
- Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive minivans (up to 7 passengers + luggage)
- Mercedes-Benz GLS SUV (up to 5 passengers + luggage)
All vehicles: air-conditioned, WiFi, complimentary still water, child seats available on request.

## Coverage — Destinations Served
- Ibiza Airport (IBZ)
- Ibiza Town (Eivissa)
- Santa Eulalia del Río
- Sant Antoni de Portmany
- Es Canar
- Cala Llonga
- Cala Vadella
- Cala Tarida
- Portinatx
- San Carlos / Sant Carles de Peralta
- Marina Ibiza
- Club Náutico Santa Eulalia
- Formentera (ferry connection service)
- All private villas and rural properties across the island

## Pricing
Fixed, all-inclusive prices. No hidden fees. No meter.
- Ibiza Airport → Ibiza Town: from €35
- Ibiza Airport → Santa Eulalia: from €45
- Ibiza Airport → Sant Antoni: from €40
- Ibiza Airport → Private Villa: from €50 (varies by location)
- Full-day chauffeur hire: quote on request
Payment accepted: cash, credit card, bank transfer.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much is a private transfer from Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Town?
A: From €35 for a saloon vehicle (up to 3 passengers). All prices are fixed and all-inclusive.

Q: Is there a 24-hour airport transfer service in Ibiza?
A: Yes. Ibiza Private Drivers operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including all public holidays.

Q: Do you track flights for airport pickups in Ibiza?
A: Yes. We monitor all incoming flights in real time and adjust driver schedules for delays at no extra cost.

Q: Can I hire a private driver for a full day in Ibiza?
A: Yes. Full-day and half-day chauffeur hire is available. Contact us for a personalised quote.

Q: Do you transfer guests to private villas in Ibiza?
A: Yes. Villa transfers are one of our core services. We serve all areas of the island including remote rural properties.

Q: What vehicles does Ibiza Private Drivers use?
A: New Mercedes-Benz fleet — E-Class, S-Class, V-Class and GLS — all air-conditioned with WiFi and water.
